notes: The parts list says 5 hook-up wires, but the circuit image shows 6 (orange 5V, black Arduino GND, yellow pin 2, blue pin 3, and two short black GND wires from the module's two GND pins to the ground rail). I built all 6.

The Memsic module straddles the centre gap. Its bottom pin row sits in the a-e half (bank t) and its top pin row sits in the f-j half (bank b), at columns 17-19. I mapped them as follows. Bottom row: GND.1 at 17, XOUT at 18, VDD at 19. Top row: GND.2 at 17, YOUT at 18, TOUT at 19. TOUT (temperature) is left unconnected, as in the schematic.
The exact rail hole numbers (bn.6, bn.12, bn.16) are estimated from the image. The ground rail is the lower rail's top row (the black '-' line).
Wire ends are placed on the same column strip as the module pin in a different row, e.g. 19t.a for the 5V wire.
The Arduino GND wire is attached to GND.1. The image shows it on one of the two GND header pins next to 5V.
The USB cable connects the Arduino to the computer so serial data can be sent. The computer is not modelled, and the cable's ports are not specified.
